player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped the exploration prematurely after returning to the starting room (Sauna), assuming all reachable areas were visited. I did not verify if the current room's unvisited neighbors were fully explored before declaring "DONE". Next time, I will maintain a mental set of visited rooms and only output "DONE" when the set of visited rooms equals the set of all rooms I have encountered. Specifically, upon returning to the Sauna, I should have checked the available directions (east) to see if the Gallery was already visited; since it was, I should have continued exploring other branches or confirmed no new rooms existed by checking the current room's neighbors against the visited list, rather than immediately stopping. I will ensure the graph edges are correctly updated to reflect the path taken (e.g., adding the edge between Sauna and Gallery when moving east) to accurately represent the map structure.
